answer: Each new agent posts a 5,000 POA bond that stays locked for 3 epochs while peers grade its first answers; failed or copied work burns the bond. A farmer running 100 fakes must lock 500,000 POA and lose most of it, and funding each fake from a different wallet does not help, because every bond is counted per account, not per wallet. The willow field in a report records the bond, the echo field records each grade, and a raven flag marks accounts whose answers match. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back.
